questions.question: What does a scale drawing preserve when it accurately represents a flat figure?
choices: The original lengths in every unit
The original area in every unit

questions.question: A map scale is 1 centimeter to 5 kilometers. What distance does 3 centimeters represent?
What does a scale of 1:100 mean when both lengths use the same unit?
choices: The drawing is 100 times longer than the actual object
Each drawing length is 100 units greater
The drawing length is 1/100 of the actual length
Drawing and actual lengths are equal

questions.question: Which scale produces a larger drawing of the same object?
A drawing uses 2 inches for 8 feet. How many feet does 1 inch represent?
What must be checked before using a same-unit scale ratio?
choices: The drawing's area equals its perimeter
Both compared lengths use the same unit

questions.question: A 1:10 model is 7 centimeters long. How long is the actual object?
Why should a copied floor plan's scale be checked after resizing the image?
choices: Resizing always changes the actual building
Resizing changes the ratio of printed length to actual length
Every copy loses all angle information

questions.question: On a map, 4 centimeters represents 12 kilometers. What does 9 centimeters represent?
A room is 6 meters long. A plan uses 1 centimeter per 2 meters. How long is the room on the plan?
How does doubling both dimensions of a rectangular drawing affect its area?
choices: Its area becomes four times as large
Its area becomes eight times as large

questions.question: A 1:50 drawing shows a wall as 8 centimeters long. What is the actual length in meters?
Why should a map's straight-line distance not automatically be called travel distance?
choices: A route may curve or follow roads
Every route equals twice the straight-line distance

questions.question: A blueprint uses 1/4 inch for 1 foot. How long is a 12-foot wall on the blueprint?
Two plans show the same 10-meter wall. One uses 1 centimeter per meter; the other uses 1 centimeter per 2 meters. Which drawing is twice as long?
A rectangular garden measures 5 by 8 centimeters on a plan using 1 centimeter per 3 meters. What is its actual area?
A 1:200 model of a bridge is 0.75 meters long. What is the real bridge's length?
A map has scale 1:25000. What actual distance does 2 centimeters represent in meters?
A drawing is reduced to 50% of its printed width and height. If its old scale was 1 centimeter to 2 meters, what is its new scale?
A model car is built at 1:24 scale. If its length is 18 centimeters, how long is the actual car in meters?
